caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic mug centered on a plain, light beige background. The mug has a round body with a slight taper at the base and a curved handle attached to its left side. Its surface is decorated with an irregular mottled pattern composed of green, brown, and dark blue-black patches against a pale yellowish base color. The rim of the mug is outlined with a thin, darker line, and the interior is shaded with a light beige tone, matching the background. There are no other objects or elements in the composition.
title: Large Mug
